# I_CNDNCONTRSOURCEDOCCATTEXT

**This CDS view provides the prerequisites for answering questions about condition contract source document category. This view determines if the condition contract was generated by a trade promotion, sales order, provider contract, and so on. These are the values associated with the document category: 01 PMR 02 Trade Promotion 12 Sales Order/Contract 22 Provider Contract 99 External Document**
